title: Child Language Acquisition
description: The biological bases of language; the stage by stage acquisition of the phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantics of the child's first language; the child's developing metalinguistic abilities; and the child's growing awareness of the form and function of speech acts, as well as the discourse rules governing conversations.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of PSYC 370B, PSYC 369, LING 369, LING 370B.
